faqs.q: Can I cancel and get a refund?
faqs.a: You can cancel for free up to 7 days before departure. Cancellations within 3-7 days get a 50% refund. No refund for cancellations under 3 days.

faqs.q: Are children under a certain age free?
faqs.a: Children under 5 are free (no separate bed). Children from 5-11 are charged 75% of adult price.
You should bring comfortable clothes, walking shoes, sunscreen, and personal medicine if needed. Also fully charge your phone for photos!

placeDetail.notFoundDesc: The place you are looking for does not exist or has been removed.

faqs.q: Is this place suitable for young children?
faqs.a: Yes, this is a suitable destination for all ages. However, you should check the road conditions if you have children under 3 years old.
Free or cheap parking is available depending on the location. You should arrive early on weekends for a good spot.

faqs.q: When is the best time to visit?
faqs.a: The best time is from November to April when the weather is cool with little rain. However, each season has its own beauty.
